findings.rule: No clause on period of cover, product tier or territory was supplied, so cover cannot be confirmed.
findings.explanation: The incident date falls inside the policy period and the premium was paid. The cover, tier and territory rules were not supplied, so this needs review.

findings.rule: A claim must be notified within 30 calendar days of the incident date.
findings.calculation: 1 day is not more than 30 days
findings.explanation: The claim was notified within the window, so no exception was needed.

findings.rule: No exclusion clauses (alcohol, drugs, licence, vehicle use, unlisted driver, registration) were supplied.
findings.explanation: The exclusion rules are missing, so they cannot be applied. No override was recorded.

findings.rule: No triage or track precedence clause was supplied, so the FAST track cannot be validated.
findings.explanation: The track criteria and precedence rules were not supplied. It is unclear whether a fraud score of 40 (elevated band) affects the track.

findings.rule: POL-CLM-001 4.1, which says when an assessment is required, was not supplied.
findings.explanation: Whether an assessment was required cannot be determined without the trigger rule.

findings.rule: No approval authority or dual-approval clauses were supplied.
findings.explanation: Whether L1 approval was enough for this payment and fraud band cannot be checked.

findings.rule: The points for indicator D-04 are not in the supplied catalogue, so the score cannot be verified. The band rules beyond 4.1 and 4.2 were also not supplied.

evidence.value: Photo metadata shows images captured 11 days before the reported incident date. Enhanced verification completed 17 September. Claimant described the claims process in unusual detail.

findings.calculation: C-04 = 5 points. D-04 = unknown. Recorded score 40 cannot be reconciled.
findings.explanation: Only the circumstance indicators (C-codes) were supplied. The score of 40 is in the 30-59 elevated band, and enhanced verification is recorded as done. The recorded interview and the suspension record cannot be confirmed. Any SIU referral rule was not supplied.

findings.rule: PHOTOS must be at least four photographs within 7 days. The POLICE_EVENT rule for collisions (POL-DOC-005 4.1) was not supplied.

evidence.value: Photo metadata shows images captured 11 days before the reported incident date. Enhanced verification completed 17 September. Claimant described the claims process in unusual detail.

findings.explanation: All other required document codes are on file and docs were complete on 2026-09-16. The photo metadata puts the photos' validity in doubt. Whether a police event number was required for this collision cannot be determined.

findings.rule: A fast-track claim must be decided within 5 business days of lodgement.
findings.calculation: 3 business days is not more than 5 business days
findings.explanation: The decision deadline was met. The supplied clauses set no per-claim acknowledgement, communication or payment deadlines. The 5.1 figures are portfolio targets only.

findings.rule: No excess, GST/ITC or recovery clauses were supplied, so the settlement amount cannot be verified.
findings.explanation: The arithmetic is consistent with the recorded facts. The rules that fix the correct excess were not supplied.
